item.title: Flowy - Self-Hosted Household Finance
item.description:
Flowy - Self-Hosted Household Finance

Open-source, self-hosted finance platform for shared household budgeting and financial organization. It is designed to replace disconnected banking apps, spreadsheets, and shared Google Sheets with a single collaborative workspace.

item.title: Pappice - Self-Hosted Support Desk
item.description:
Pappice - Self-Hosted Support Desk

Open-source, self-hosted support desk with a chat-style ticket workflow. It can run as a single binary or through Docker Compose, and supports customer conversations, internal notes, assignments, and ticket lifecycle tracking.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Conatus - Self-Hosted Task Manager
item.description:
Conatus - Self-Hosted Task Manager

Open-source, self-hosted task manager for projects, recurring work, reminders, collaboration, and automation. It includes Docker deployment and MCP/OpenAPI integration, and is positioned as a Todoist-inspired alternative.
item.content:encoded:
Conatus - Self-Hosted Task Manager

item.title: BaryMusic - Live Lyrics and Setlist Manager
item.description:
BaryMusic - Live Lyrics and Setlist Manager

Web app for organizing songs and setlists, then displaying live lyrics on external screens through built-in channels. It is available as a Windows portable app or Docker deployment and includes an editor for lyrics and song structure.
item.content:encoded:
BaryMusic - Live Lyrics and Setlist Manager

Web app for organizing songs and setlists, then displaying live lyrics on external screens through built-in channels. It is available as a Windows portable app or Docker deployment and includes an editor for lyrics and song structure.

item.title: Tracearr - Media Server Monitoring
item.description:
Tracearr - Media Server Monitoring

Open-source monitoring dashboard for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby servers. It tracks streams and playback activity, analyzes server use, and can flag account-sharing patterns; Docker deployment is supported.
item.content:encoded:
Tracearr - Media Server Monitoring

item.title: SlowBooks Pro - Local Accounting Software
item.description:
SlowBooks Pro - Local Accounting Software

Free, source-available desktop accounting software for double-entry bookkeeping, invoicing, inventory, payroll, and bank feeds. It includes an optional multi-user server edition and positions itself as a local, no-cloud alternative to QuickBooks Pro.
item.content:encoded:
SlowBooks Pro - Local Accounting Software

item.title: Notifuse - Self-Hosted Email Marketing
item.description:
Notifuse - Self-Hosted Email Marketing

Open-source, self-hosted platform for newsletters, email marketing, and transactional email. It includes a visual MJML editor, Liquid templates, and support for multiple sending providers.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Attic - Self-Hosted Home Inventory
item.description:
Attic - Self-Hosted Home Inventory

Open-source home-inventory manager for tracking household belongings, categories, attributes, and asset history. It supports Docker deployment, local or OIDC authentication, and S3-compatible storage.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Hermes Android - Client for the Hermes WebUI
item.description:
Hermes Android - Client for the Hermes WebUI

Official Android app for Hermes WebUI, letting you chat with Hermes from your phone or tablet. Features encrypted settings, a notification bridge, share-intent support, and updates via Play and GitHub releases.
item.content:encoded:
Hermes Android - Client for the Hermes WebUI

Official Android app for Hermes WebUI, letting you chat with Hermes from your phone or tablet. Features encrypted settings, a notification bridge, share-intent support, and updates via Play and GitHub releases.

item.title: Fottly - Self-hosted image transformation service
item.description:
Fottly - Self-hosted image transformation service

Open-source, self-hosted alternative to Cloudinary for image transformation. Fastify + Sharp service offering resize, format conversion, cropping, watermarking and AI background removal (Rembg), with optional S3-compatible storage and caching.
item.content:encoded:
Fottly - Self-hosted image transformation service

Open-source, self-hosted alternative to Cloudinary for image transformation. Fastify + Sharp service offering resize, format conversion, cropping, watermarking and AI background removal (Rembg), with optional S3-compatible storage and caching.
